lines: d37: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Esteban Peng is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d37: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d37: 🕯️ Esteban is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d37: Thornfield watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d37: 🕯️ Esteban Peng is dead — the arena. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d37: What Esteban kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d37: "Esteban's gone." Caleb looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Esteban." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d37: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Regina blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d37: 📖 LEARNED: Camp Cooking (Level 1). Cooking uses half the water, +10% kcal. Once per day: add a Secret Ingredient (a random inventory item) — 50% delicious (+morale), 50% educational.
d37: 📖 LEARNED: Boiling Water (Level 1). Rolling boil for 1 minute kills most pathogens. The simplest safe water.
d37: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.

d37: The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Esteban's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
d37: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d37: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Esteban Peng, 37 days. The mantle passes to Regina Prado.
d37: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Regina Prado, 25 — a Chef. Her hands know different work now: The Touch, Green Whisper, Green Thumb, Literally.
d37: The village's quarrel was with Esteban — and Esteban is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d37: At the grave, Judith, Caleb, Alina and 5 more speak for Regina — "Esteban trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d37: The fire knew Regina before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
